name: atlas-studio
description: Atlas Studio workspace. Rust engineering semantics live under core/runtime/adapter; TypeScript UI lives under apps/studio; .ynventa is the sole repository knowledge root and tools/atlas the Atlas control root.

scripts.atlas:contract: cargo run -p atlas-cli --bin atlas-systemizer -- contract --format json
scripts.atlas:systemize: cargo run -p atlas-cli --bin atlas-systemizer -- systemize --root . --out target/atlas/systemize-report.json
scripts.atlas:docs:audit: cargo run -p atlas-cli --bin atlas-systemizer -- docs audit --root .
scripts.atlas:code:analyze: cargo run -p atlas-cli --bin atlas-systemizer -- code analyze --root .
